scenario: A utility billing specialist processes a disconnected customer's reconnection application. The workflow extracts the reconnection application, payment-plan enrollment confirmation, and current-balance statement from uploaded PDFs, computes the outstanding balance and deposit credit to verify all financial prerequisites are satisfied, and then applies PUC regulatory rules to produce a reconnection-authorization memo specifying Restore or Deny.
info_flow: pdf-extract parses the reconnection application, payment-plan confirmation letter, and balance statement into plain text → financial-calculator computes the deposit credit against the outstanding balance to determine any residual amount owed → presale-regulation-auditor applies PUC reconnection rules to the computed balance result and issues a Restore or Deny authorization memo.
